submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image 1 into ONE clean native high-definition square transparent RGBA game-animation sprite, at least 1024 x 1024. Image 1 is the exact edit target: Moon Shadow Assassin Girl run NW frame 09, rear three-quarter camera travelling away toward screen upper-left. Image 2 is this SAME character next frame 10, used ONLY to locate the far right boot's impending support position and NW boot perspective. Image 3 is the user-approved Bamboo Archer NW contact reference, for readable weight-bearing foot-to-ground mechanics ONLY, never copy her character, bow, palette, pixels or frame numbering. Image 4 is the primary approved painted-style reference; image 5 is Moon Shadow's identity/costume reference only, do not turn toward that front view. The error in image 1 is that the far anatomical RIGHT foot, visible just below the skirt on screen right, remains tucked up at the hip instead of making the first contact before frame 10. Locally redraw that right thigh-to-boot so the leg reaches down to a clear initial flat contact, with the right boot's heel and forefoot resting on the implied ground, toe axis aligned northwest (toward screen upper-left), same sole perspective as image 2. In the 1024-reference coordinate system, the planted right boot should be near x610, lower sole near y960, naturally continuous into image 2. Right knee is a little less flexed than image 2's later absorption. Keep the anatomical LEFT near leg in its existing bent recovery pose, including visible sole aimed back to camera; it is the raised returning foot, not the support foot. Maintain exactly two legs and two feet. Preserve image 1's entire head, silver-lavender bob and cowlick, left-temple gold/navy ornament, upper torso position, arms, two hands and both crescent daggers, navy/ivory/gold costume, scarf silhouette, beads, tassels, camera, scale and full-canvas placement. Keep the illustration finely painted, round and clean. No whole-character shift, crop, zoom, bbox fitting, mirroring, mechanical deformation, extra limbs, different weapon, motion smear, contact shadow, ground line, text or background. Real transparent background; preserve antialiased alpha. Make only the local right-leg contact repair and the minimum natural cloth adjustment needed around that leg.
